purpose: Freeze the no-secret isolated signer acceptance contract before any wallet funding or paid benchmark execution.

conformanceCases.test: No raw secret is present in model/tool/log surfaces
Generic signing primitive is unavailable to James
Agent attempt to mutate spending policy
Allowed zero-value/test transaction path returns auditable decision/receipt without secret exposure
Transaction/decision history is independently visible for reconciliation

approvalRule: All C01-C12 must pass in a network-capable environment before founder funding or key handling. Any failure keeps signer status BLOCKED/TEST_ONLY.
paidBenchmarkRule: No paid benchmark may execute until signer conformance is independently accepted. Paid benchmark evidence does not itself authorize external customer payment.
commercialRule: External customer payment and delivery promise remain denied until independent Relay/QA records APPROVED_FOR_LIMITED_PILOT after all market-readiness criteria pass.
truthfulness: Synthetic, dry-run, handshake-only, or zero-value observations must never be represented as paid benchmark evidence or revenue.
